verdict.rationale: The MCP server can create broadcasts via natural language, implying a draft/queued campaign can be produced by an agent, but there is no documented approval/hold-for-human-review workflow or explicit 'scheduled pending approval' state before send. missing for 10: explicit approval-gating or human-review-before-send workflow, documentation of a queued/pending state distinct from immediate send, evidence of segment-targeted broadcast drafting via the agent.
